title: Craftify
description: Craftify adds crafting recipes for the most important uncraftable items in Minecraft, like name-tags, tridents, etc.. It focuses only on essential items, leaving the rest of the game’s crafting unchanged.
body:
Craftify expands your crafting possibilities by giving uncraftable items an actual recipe. Make everything from tridents and name-tags to totems and saddles

Included:
- Bell
- Chainmail Armor (Full set)
- Cobweb
- Crying Obsidian
- Horse Armor (Full set)
- Elytra
- Enchanted Golden Apple (Notch Apple)
- Name Tag
- Saddle
- Totem Of Undying
- Trident 

Recipes below

<details>
  <summary>Recipes</summary>

  <details>
    <summary>Bell</summary>
    3 Sticks in the top row
    3 Gold ingots in the mid row
    2 Gold ingots and 1 gold nugget in the middle in the bottom row
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Chainmail Helmet</summary>
    The shape of an helmet with chains
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Chainmail Chestplate</summary>
    The shape of an chestplate with chains
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Chainmail Leggings</summary>
   The shape of an leggings with chains
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Chainmail Boots</summary>
    The shape of boots with chains
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Cobweb</summary>
    Form an X with strings
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Crying Obsidian</summary>
    1 Obsidian in the middle
    4 Amethyst Shards in an + shape around the obsidian
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Leather Horse Armor</summary>
    3 Leather in the right column
    1 Saddle in the middle
    2 Leather in the left column on the bottom
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Iron Horse Armor</summary>
    3 Iron Ingots in the right column
    1 Saddle in the middle
    2 Iron Ingots in the left column on the bottom
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Golden Horse Armor</summary>
    3 Gold Ingots in the right column
    1 Saddle in the middle
    2 Gold Ingots in the left column on the bottom
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Diamond Horse Armor</summary>
    3 Diamonds in the right column
    1 Saddle in the middle
    2 Diamonds in the left column on the bottom
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Elytra</summary>
    2 Strings and 1 Phantom Membrane in the middle in the top row 
    1 Netherite Ingot in the middle middle
    2 Phantom Membrane under each string (4 Phantom Membrane all in all)
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Enchanted Golden Apple (Notch Apple)</summary>
    1 Apple in the middle middle
    8 Blocks Of Gold around it
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Name Tag</summary>
    1 Paper in the bottom left
    1 Iron Ingot in the middle middle
    1 String in the top right
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Saddle</summary>
    1 Iron Ingot in the middle middle
    2 Leather next to the Iron Ingot (left and right)
    1 Leather on top of the iron ingot
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Totem Of Undying</summary>
    2 Emeralds in the top left and right corners
    1 End Crystal in the middle middle
    4 Gold Ingots in an + shape around the end crystal
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>Trident</summary>
    3 Prismarine Shards in the top row
    2 Sticks in the middle column forming a pickaxe
  </details>

</details>
